title: Blocked Digest Truth: readiness blockers cannot disappear

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.173 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed v0.15.173 release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow digest/report-truth repair; focused coverage plus normal gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: Fresh v0.15.172 browser evidence justified the fix. A fresh v0.15.173 ZIP/log audit is still required after deploy.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: The release is grounded in fresh deployed v0.15.172 Python browser evidence where quality reached 100/A and export verification passed, but the package still blocked before ZIP while the digest hid the readiness blocker.
The v0.15.172 run blocked on a visible Course Map readiness issue for notebook/model-card lab assets, but the emitted digest carried blocker counts with an empty flaggedChecks list.
Finish-pass readiness blockers and warnings are now passed into the run digest and appear in gates.flaggedChecks even when quality and export verification pass.
proofCommands: rg -n "readinessBlockers|buildReadinessChecks|Non-data-science package references notebook/model-card" src/AppFlow.jsx src/lib/runDigest.js src/lib/__tests__/runDigest.test.js

claims.summary: If a blocked finish ever reports blocker counts without blocker detail, the digest emits a failed package check stating that no blocker detail reached the digest.
proofCommands: rg -n "no blocker detail reached the digest|readiness blocker" src/lib/runDigest.js src/lib/__tests__/runDigest.test.js

claims.summary: The release explicitly does not claim a fresh clean ZIP score; deployed v0.15.173 still needs a GPT-5.4-mini ZIP/log audit.
proofCommands: rg -n "may not claim|fresh v0.15.173|ZIP/log audit" docs/V0.15.173_BLOCKED_DIGEST_TRUTH_ROADMAP.md release-contracts/v0.15.173.json

knownRemainingTargets: Fresh deployed v0.15.173 GPT-5.4-mini ZIP/log proof must verify the readiness blocker appears in the digest when download is blocked.
The notebook/model-card lab asset heuristic may need narrowing for introductory Python courses if fresh evidence shows it is over-broad.
Source/genome proof remains incomplete when the digest reports 0/12 genome coverage and 0 concept-linked citations.
Texture below 100 remains a strict-clean target even when structural quality is high.
All export surfaces must agree before any clean score is claimed.
